errors.text_span: най-високите стълбове са за Турция, Сърбия, Македония и Монтенегро, като стойността им надвишава 40%
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly claims that the values for Serbia and Montenegro exceed 40%. The chart shows their values are below 40%, at approximately 39% and 38% respectively.
The label on the x-axis is 'Северна Македония' (North Macedonia), not just 'Македония'.

errors.text_span: най-ниските са за Чехия, Дания, Германия и Финландия, със стойности под 15%
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that Germany's value is under 15%. The chart shows Germany's bar is exactly on the 15% line.
The value for Bulgaria is visibly below the 35% line, at approximately 34%. Describing it as 'около 35%' (around 35%) is an inaccurate approximation.

errors.text_span: като се намира в средната част на диаграмата
errors.evidence: Bulgaria's value of approximately 34% is among the highest values shown in the chart, not in the 'middle part' of the range of values.
